name: VIPZone – VIP Customer & Product Management for WooCommerce
author: Devtree

sections.description:
VIPZone enhances your WooCommerce shop by adding a powerful VIP customer management system. It allows you to create exclusive shopping experiences by assigning specific products, custom stock levels, and special prices to your VIP customers.

Key Features

  • VIP Customer Management: Create and manage VIP customers with dedicated dashboards
  • Product Assignment: Assign specific products to VIP customers
  • Custom Stock Levels: Set individual stock limits for each VIP customer
  • Special Pricing: Define custom prices for products assigned to VIP customers
  • Order Tracking: Monitor VIP customer orders and stock usage
  • Status Management: Handle customer lifecycle (pending, VIP, rejected, deleted)
  • Modern Interface: Clean and intuitive admin interface built with Vue.js
  • Full Integration: Seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce and WordPress
  • Tiered Pricing Plans: Choose between Free, PRO, and Ultimate plans to match your business needs
  • Visibility Control: Hide products, prices, titles from non-VIP users
  • Shop Access Management: Control shop visibility and access for non-VIP users
  • Content Protection: Blur products for non-VIP users with customizable effects
  • Customization Options: Personalize buttons and VIP request dialogs
  • Support Levels: Access standard, premium, or priority support based on your plan

Perfect For

  • Wholesale businesses
  • B2B commerce
  • Exclusive retail shops
  • Member-only stores
  • Any business requiring customer-specific product management

Premium Support

Need help? Our dedicated support team is here to assist you:

  • Detailed documentation
  • Priority email support
  • Regular updates and improvements

External Services

VIPZone uses minimal external services to ensure the best experience for our users while maintaining transparency about data usage. For complete information about our terms of service and privacy policy, please visit:

  • Terms of Service: https://vipzone.devtree.fr/terms.php
  • Privacy Policy: https://vipzone.devtree.fr/privacy.php

License Validation Service

  • Purpose: The plugin connects to our license validation service (api.devtree.fr) only when using premium features and addons
  • Free Usage: The core plugin can be used completely free without any license or external service calls
  • Data Transmitted: When validating a premium license, we only send:
    • License key
    • Domain name
    • Plugin version
    • WordPress version
  • Privacy: No personal data, customer information, or business data is ever transmitted
  • Frequency: License validation occurs only:
    • When activating a premium license
    • Once per day for active premium licenses
    • When updating premium addons
  • Transparency: All API calls to external services are documented in our code and this readme

No External Services for Core Features

  • The free version of VIPZone operates completely independently
  • All core VIP customer management features work without external services
  • No data is collected or transmitted for basic plugin operation
  • Premium features and addons require license validation for updates and support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/vipzone directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. Go to VIPZone settings to configure the plugin
  5. Start creating VIP customers and assigning products

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, VIPZone is a WooCommerce extension and requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Can I assign different prices to different VIP customers?

Yes, you can set custom prices for each product on a per-VIP customer basis.

How does stock management work?

Each VIP customer can have their own assigned stock for specific products, separate from the general WooCommerce stock.

Is it compatible with my theme?

VIPZone is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme and integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce templates.

If you encounter any compatibility issues with your theme, please contact our support team who can help with custom CSS modifications to ensure perfect integration with your specific theme.

Can I limit product visibility to specific VIP customers?

Yes, products can be assigned to specific VIP customers, and they will only see their assigned products when shopping.

screenshots.caption: VIP products on the WooCommerce shop: Three screenshots showing how VIP products appear to non-VIP users, including the blurred product effect, the 'Become VIP' button, and the popup dialog to request access to the VIP program.

Home page: Overview of VIP product management. Add VIP customers, create VIP products, and access quick links to VIP management, products, statistics, and settings. Modern and intuitive dashboard for WooCommerce VIP features.
Add VIP customer: The interface to add a new VIP customer and assign specific products, custom stock, and pricing to them. Easily manage which products each VIP can access and at what price.
Main VIP customer dashboard showing the list of customers with their status, assigned products count, and order amounts. Features a clean interface with filtering options and quick actions.
Product assignment interface where you can manage which products are available to each VIP customer, set custom prices, and define individual stock limits.
Stats tracking interface that provides detailed insights into VIP customer purchases, stock usage, and order history

Customization interface: Easily personalize the VIP experience with customizable button texts, dialog messages, and access links. Instantly preview changes to the interface for both the 'Become VIP' button and VIP request dialogs.
Plugin settings panel where you can configure global options, default values
